independent_checks: Independently computed complex 2x2 SVD moments over 4,500 random rank-one configurations for p=.25,.6,.92 and equal/unequal amplitudes; each respected sharp F and G>=KQ. Ten independent projection-pair examples at Q=0,.1,.8,1.5,2 attained F within 1e-10.
These bounded numerical diagnostics are not the proof of uniform all-Hilbert-space or all-parameter claims; the exact Gram/Stieltjes derivation is.
limitations: Finite computations verify only the stated bounded instances or exact algebraic certificates; all-parameter scope relies on mathematical proof.
correctness.rationale: The two singular-value squares of A±B are determined by s=a²+b²±2ab Re(<u,x><y,v>) and P=a²b²(1−c²)(1−d²). For r=p/2 in (0,1), their power sum Psi_r(s,P) increases separately with s and P, including degeneracies by limiting argument. For fixed Q=c²+d², t=cd≤Q/2 increases both possible maxima, giving a positive-projection extremizer with eigenvalues (a+b±sqrt((a-b)²+2abQ))/2. Stieltjes z^p integral differentiated in interior gives F'<0 and F''<0, hence G=a^p+b^p−F strictly increasing/convex; its tangent at Q=0 gives sharp K for unequal/equal amplitudes and limiting Q→0 proves optimality. Checked Q=0 and Q=2 boundaries and infinite-dimensional reduction to rank-two corners.
